systems.system: law enforcement system (digital capacity development and training)
systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology runs the training; the bodies named are the Ministry of Interior, the Public Prosecution and all levels of courts
systems.tiers: over 8,300 individuals trained in 2023, 13,493 in total; no station count or level given

note: The communications ministry's 2023 review: for law enforcement it reports digital training only, and an AI voice-to-text and investigation-report project with the Ministry of Justice and the Cabinet. It describes no system in which stations record reports or cases.
